subject.title: Feature: Subscribe to WhatsApp call events (Baileys)

question: Should OpenClaw expose inbound WhatsApp calls only as transient sanitized plugin events, or also own durable per-contact activity history for agent reminders?
rationale: Current main has no approved contact-activity storage or query contract, and the durable option changes privacy, retention, identity resolution, deduplication, session-state, and plugin API behavior.

options.title: Transient sanitized events
options.body: Add an opt-in WhatsApp-local event path with stable call-ID/status normalization and no durable storage.

options.title: Durable contact history
options.body: Design an explicit SQLite-backed model with retention, identity resolution, access controls, deduplication, and query APIs.

options.title: Decline inbound tracking
options.body: Keep the existing outbound-only call capability and avoid collecting inbound call activity.

recommendation.title: Transient sanitized events
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in WhatsApp-local event path with stable call-ID/status normalization and no durable storage.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined product-discussion, monitor-history, and adjacent WhatsApp-call implementation evidence.
